gloss: to come across; to meet by chance; to finally meet

definitions.gloss: to come across by chance; to meet at last
definitions.explanation: To meet a person, or come upon a thing or chance, as if by fate, often after a long time or a long search. It carries an emotional, sometimes romantic tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I met the person I was destined for.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅先|たびさき}→旅先：12949_tabisaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}えた。
examples.english: On my trip I happened upon a wonderful book.

examples.japanese: {二十年|にじゅうねん}ぶり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}った⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}った。
examples.english: The brothers, meeting again after twenty years, embraced without a word.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧ (to go around) + ⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (to meet): after going around, to meet at last. The partner or thing met takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (or ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ for two people meeting each other). Also written {巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}う and めぐり{会|あ}う; the noun ⟦{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ→巡り合わせ：07400_meguriawase⟧ means fate or the turn of fortune.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}う: to meet one's destined partner
- ⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}う: to come upon a chance
- {巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}えた⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧: the good fortune of having met

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出会|であ}う→出会う：02298_deau⟧: to meet; to encounter — the everyday word, without the sense of long searching or fate
- ⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet — the plain verb for any meeting, planned or not
